map.由比冲等效速度与质量比求 Δv 使用指南: Δv from Equivalent Exhaust Velocity and Mass Ratio User Guide
map.输入有效排气速度 v_e、初始质量 m₀ 与末质量 m_f，求速度增量。: Enter the effective exhaust velocity v_e, the initial mass m₀ and the final mass m_f to compute the velocity increment.
map.火箭速度增量 Δv = v_e·ln(m₀/m_f)，v_e 为排气速度。: Rocket velocity increment Δv = v_e·ln(m₀/m_f), where v_e is the exhaust velocity.
map.由比冲 Isp 与质量比，评估上面级或姿控段的机动能力。: Use the specific impulse and the mass ratio to assess the manoeuvre capability of an upper stage or an attitude control phase.
map.对比不同排气速度（电推/化推）下的 Δv 效率。: Compare Δv efficiency across exhaust velocities (electric versus chemical propulsion).
map.：排气速度 v_e=2500 m/s、初始质量 m₀=100 t、末质量 m_f: Exhaust velocity v_e=2500 m/s, initial mass m₀=100 t and final mass m_f=20 t give Δv=2500×ln(100/20)=2500×ln(5)=2500×1.609≈4023 m/s ≈ 4.02 km/s, enough for most orbital transfer stages.
map.这个公式和齐奥尔科夫斯基公式什么关系？: How does this formula relate to the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation?
map.同一回事：Δv=Isp·g₀·ln(m₀/m_f)，而排气速度 v_e=Isp·: They are the same thing: Δv = Isp·g₀·ln(m₀/m_f), while the exhaust velocity v_e = Isp·g₀, so Δv = v_e·ln(m₀/m_f). One states it with specific impulse and the other with exhaust velocity, but the substance is identical.
map.电推进排气速度高但推力小，怎么选？: Electric propulsion has a high exhaust velocity but low thrust, so how do I choose?
map.电推 v_e 可达数 km/s 甚至更高（Δv 效率极高），但推力毫牛级，只适合: Electric propulsion can reach exhaust velocities of several km/s or more (very high Δv efficiency) but the thrust is in the millinewton range, so it suits long-duration on-orbit manoeuvres; high-thrust chemical propulsion is used for orbit insertion and transfer. Choose by the mission timescale.
